thread:
claire: Hey runtime — marketing needs a compact, auditable benchmark smoke pack for the launch blog. Minimal, reproducible, and no cherry-picking. Can you run a few targeted reruns and dump a tiny artifact set we can attach?

claire: Short checklist:
- Warmup profile: 15rps -> 180rps over 5m (linear) with light poisson jitter; hold 180rps for 7m (~8k requests). Capture p50/p95/p99 + full time series CSV.
- Coldstart sweep: 2.5k single-shot requests across fresh replicas, produce latency bucket heatmap + raw CSV.
- Quant variants: fp16, q4_0, q5_1 (if q5_1 OOMs, note fallback).
- Long-context tail: 9k token prompts (30 samples) both cold KV and warm KV.
- Streaming vs non-stream micro-check (10 samples each).
- Include samples_manifest.json (sample IDs, seed, md5), runbook.txt with exact curl commands, and checksums.txt.

noah: Which model and cohort? Also confirm embargo.

claire: Use model: "redwood-x-7b-lm" and cohort: marketing_cohort_v5. Use seed=2024 for sampling. Embargo: yes, until launch week. Mark any experimental flags.

ethan: Plan: schedule three jobs on pool-3: job-warmup-33001, job-cold-33002, job-quant-33003. Artifacts to s3://internal-bench/marketing/1770004321/. We'll include md5 for each artifact and a SHA256 of the run metadata.

ruth: For the blog we just need a single PNG (warmup_curve_blog.png) sized for the post and the underlying warmup_timeseries.csv. Product also asked for a plain-language claims_line in claims_audit.txt mapping the p95 to a sentence.

ethan: Example manifest snippet we'll include (token redacted):

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED\" \ 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-x-7b-lm","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":1024,"stream":false}'
```

ethan: ETA for full artifacts: 18-30h. If you need a preview earlier I can run a 1k warmup_preview and drop warmup_preview.png by EOD.

noah: Preview would be useful for copy review. Please tag @noah and @claire when manifest + artifacts land.

runtime-bot: job-warmup-33001 queued on pool-3 (est runtime ~75m). Logs: https://internal.redwood/bench/runs/33001. Artifacts target: s3://internal-bench/marketing/1770004321/.

ethan: We'll also record infra provenance (instance type, CUDA, driver, kernel flags) and peak GPU mem per variant in runbook.txt for auditors. If any quant variant fails or shows >12% perf regression vs fp16 we'll log it clearly and include fallback details.

claire: Thanks — that should cover legal/product. One note: avoid cherry-picking by publishing the sample manifest and the seed so auditors can rerun.

ethan: Copy. Posting updates here when jobs complete or if errors occur.
